headline: Ashiana Housing releases latest investor presentation
summary: Ashiana Housing has filed its latest investor presentation with the NSE. The document outlines the company's current operational performance and future growth strategy. Retail investors can review these slides to understand the company's project pipeline and financial outlook.
why_it_matters: Provides insight into the company's future project pipeline and strategy.

headline: Ashiana Housing releases financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
summary: Ashiana Housing Limited has formally submitted the outcome of its board meeting along with financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Retail investors can review these filings to assess the company's operational performance, revenue growth, and profitability trends during the period. This official disclosure provides direct insight into the company's financial health.
why_it_matters: Review Ashiana Housing's latest earnings to track real estate demand.
